fields.statement: Verifier attempt 2 at 49b80f8. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/check passes; check.txtar now swaps the from/to IDs as well as the type, so the in-flight entry holds a verifies link from intent fast to capability store in an open (draft) change set, asserts rhiza check exits 0 printing 'warn in-flight change set <id>, op <id>, link <id>: link type "verifies" does not go from intent to capability', and asserts no in-flight line after rhiza withdraw.
